Reason: The provided CT images (Figures 1a-c) demonstrate a large right pleural effusion with associated compressive atelectasis of the right lung and significant cardiomegaly; in the context of this classic case, these findings correspond to the described PA chest X-ray features of right effusion, atelectasis, left second arc protrusion (suggesting pulmonary artery enlargement/left atrial appendage), and an enlarged heart shadow.
